$comment: What a policy over a pull request's receipt reads: version 1 of the input verify.py gives data.plimsoll.receipt.deny, built from the signed run only, after the signature and head checks passed. verify.py hands this schema to OPA with --schema, so a policy that reads a field not listed here fails to compile instead of never firing.

plimsoll_policy_input.description: The input's version, 1. A field is never renamed or removed under the same version.

receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the receipt bytes verified, lowercase hex.

signer.description: The key the signature checked against: trusted_key (the operator's, given to the verifier separately) or self_consistent (only the key the receipt carries, which anyone can make; such a reading is never verified).

checks.description: The verifier's own checks, true when passed. signature, head and result are always present; tests whenever the signed request asks for a test report or a minimum was given; the others when the verifier was given the file they compare.

tests.description: The returned test report lists no failure or error and at least the minimum of tests that ran.

subject.description: What the signed request says it tested, equal to what the CI configuration names (the head check).

pull_request.description: Digits, as the CI platform numbers it; 0 for a run outside a pull request.

base.description: The base commit, empty when the receipt was made without one.

agent_sessions.description: Coding-agent session IDs named by the pull request's commit trailers; empty when none.

minimum_isolation.description: The isolation floor the run asked for: none, process, container, kernel or vm.

minimum_isolation_rank.description: The floor as a number: none 0, process 1, container 2, kernel 3, vm 4, anything else -1.

steps.description: The commands the run was asked to execute, in order.

artifacts.description: The paths the run was asked to return.

provider.description: The sandbox provider that ran it, such as docker or e2b.

isolation.description: The tier the run reports: configuration and provider evidence plus a startup check, never runtime attestation.

isolation_rank.description: The tier as a number, ranked as minimum_isolation_rank; an unknown tier is -1 and meets nothing.

outcome.description: completed, setup_failed, timed_out, protocol_error or runner_failed.

steps.description: The steps that ran, in order. No output: what a step printed is the tested code's to write.

artifacts.description: The files the run returned, by digest and size, never by content.

record.description: The signed run record's own fields.
